description: Dear State Delegates, I am writing to offer my strong endorsement of Luke Searle for Utah House District 59. I have served with Luke on the Wasatch County Council for the past three years, and I have seen firsthand the kind of leader he is. Luke is the kind of public servant people hope for: engage
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Luke Searle
title: Letter from Council Chair Erik Rowland — Vote Luke Searle for Utah House District 59
